title: Shared Team AI Agent — Iteration 3 API
assumptions: A single seeded consulting team is sufficient for the localhost demo.
Private messages remain scoped to a conversation; only an explicit share action writes shared team state.
Keyword matching is the MVP retrieval mechanism; the agent response adapter is deterministic until an LLM provider is configured.
The server records a member's last-seen time when they open a session and returns their catch-up update.
The centralized information hub is persistent team context, artifacts, and activity events; the MVP polls events rather than continuously synchronizing.

errors: 400 missing, invalid, or mismatched team/user; invalid title

behavior.duplicate_work: Every meaningful POST message searches only its team's shared context before the response is generated. If related work is in progress or complete, duplicate_resolution is true, the response identifies the owner/status, returns saved Artifact records, and recommends reuse or remaining complementary work rather than repeating completed work.
behavior.catch_up: POST /api/sessions returns shared events after the server-persisted previous_last_seen_at and then advances that time. GET activity with since supplies subsequent polling updates for the Team Activity view.
behavior.authority: Facts, opinions, proposals, and decisions are separate types. Only decisions may use confirmed status; competing proposals are never silently collapsed.
behavior.privacy: A private message never becomes shared state automatically. The agent may return a share_suggestion, but the client must explicitly call POST /api/context to publish it.
behavior.conversation_creation: POST /api/conversations creates an empty private conversation owned by user_id within team_id. The server must verify that both records exist and that the user belongs to the supplied team; it must reject cross-team ownership. A missing title is assigned a server-defined safe default. The new conversation contains no messages, is visible only through that owner’s conversation list and with the existing message endpoints only when their user_id matches, and does not create shared context or activity events.
